screen: Production Business Home, People view (desktop 1440), stage 3 pass 1

expected_differences: People is selected rather than For you. A wrapping people gallery, without the people-ribbon controls or car shelf, is correct for this view.
Demo Coffee Co., Raleigh, the returned people and their source titles replace the Lab fixtures. Record names containing “demo” do not require Lab demo-provenance labels.
The D initial and uploaded coffee, café and vehicle profile images are legitimate record differences; do not replace them with fictional portraits.
Two files to approve, the absent campaign-decision link and notification badges may correctly reflect independent production queries.
Real work and video references can differ in aspect ratio and content from the Lab’s still samples.
No vehicle asking prices should appear in this People view, and people correctly have no unsolicited price or reach estimate.
keep: The 200px graphite rail, restrained TapMart lockup, selected cobalt navigation edge and existing navigation destinations.
The mineral canvas, open gallery, strong ink typography and absence of dashboard cards or app-card shadows.
The adjacent, vertically offset identity/work assemblies and wrapped second row; do not force this view into the For you ribbon.
Visible View person and Request entries, source-title links, location selection and source-specific attention link.
Literal Approved work, Instagram connected and Verified creator text when supported by the corresponding records.
review.readiness_note: The capture retains the visible functional entry points, but this desktop pass is not ready for sign-off. Correct the caption and media drift, then smoke-test source inspection, recipient-bound request choices, view changes and access to every returned person. A screenshot cannot verify those interactions.

drift.change: Remove follower totals, completed counts, ratings and review counts from discovery captions, including the People gallery. Keep those real values in person detail. Retain the source title and supported provenance/status text at IBM Plex Sans 14/20px, identity at 18/24px and actions in a 44px-high row. Allow necessary status wrapping without restoring a reputation stack.
drift.why: Jasmine’s caption includes 12.4K followers, 2 completed, a 5.0 rating and 2 reviews; demo-creator also shows followers and completion count. The approved root treatment explicitly moves these metrics into detail. Their presence makes the gallery metadata-heavy rather than work-and-request-led.

drift.change: Remove the painted landscape work housings. Size each work element from its intrinsic aspect ratio with object-fit: contain, a transparent parent and 4px media corners. For a 300px-wide 16:9 source, render 300×168.75px rather than a filled 300×192px box. A 232px media-row reservation may remain, but unused space must be canvas rather than letterboxing.
drift.why: The café work samples have visible neutral bands above and below the photographs. The Lab’s landscape work is an intact source sheet without a surrounding underlay.
drift.where: Jasmine’s work at approximately x=408, y=254, and the repeated café work in the second row

drift.change: Resolve the unlabeled coral work region using the actual asset state. For video, show its supplied poster and an opaque inspection/play control with a 44×44px target and 24px icon. If media is unavailable, replace the blank reservation with a compact literal “Work preview unavailable” state and retain any valid source link. If coral is genuinely the supplied content, preserve it but identify the source type and expose inspection; do not manufacture replacement imagery.
drift.why: The capture shows only a solid coral square. It does not communicate whether this is supplied creative, an unready video or unavailable media, so the source is not visually understandable.
drift.where: demo-creator work region, approximately x=916, y=254, 232×232px

drift.change: Use recipient-visible labels such as “Request Jasmine” and “Request demo-creator,” retaining the dropdown indicator, existing permission checks and allowed request choices. Keep IBM Plex Sans 600 at 16/20px and a minimum 44px target height.
drift.why: Both production actions say only Request, whereas the Lab reinforces the named recipient directly in each action. Preserve the dropdown functionality while restoring that explicit commitment.

drift.change: Restore the desktop title row to x=232, y=32, width=1176px and height=48px. Keep the heading at Archivo 700, 36/40px with zero default margins and vertically center it. Make the location control 48px high with an 8px radius, aligned to that row.
drift.why: The production heading begins roughly 12px lower than the Lab, and the location control begins at y=48 rather than y=32 and appears only 40px high. This is shell-spacing drift, not a consequence of selecting People.
drift.where: Page heading and Raleigh location control

review.why: The main language survived: mineral canvas, graphite rail, restrained cobalt, strong headings, open offset source assemblies and visible operational navigation. The selected People state correctly changes the composition to a wrapping gallery. However, production restores the reputation-heavy caption stack removed by approval, adds visible work letterboxing and leaves one work region visually unexplained. Money is appropriately absent here, and real statuses and attention counts remain exposed. The visible controls suggest functionality was retained, but do not prove successful requests or navigation.
review.verdict: Frame Shift is recognizable and the visible production functionality remains exposed, but caption, media and smaller control-spacing drift prevent a faithful-transfer sign-off.
